web.title: Tax cuts to help with the cost of living | Treasury.gov.au
web.description:
# Tax cuts to help with the cost of living
25 January 2024

## Cost-of-living tax cuts
The Australian Government has legislated cost-of-living tax cuts for all 13.6 million Australian taxpayers.

From 1 July 2024, the tax cuts will:

- reduce the 19 per cent tax rate to 16 per cent
- reduce the 32.5 per cent tax rate to 30 per cent
- increase the threshold above which the 37 per cent tax rate applies from $120,000 to $135,000
- increase the threshold above which the 45 per cent tax rate applies from $180,000 to $190,000

## Legislation
Legislation enacting these changes received Royal Assent on 5 March 2024.

- [Treasury Laws Amendment (Cost of Living Tax Cuts) Act 2024](https://www.legislation.gov.au/C2024A00003/latest/text)
- [Treasury Laws Amendment (Cost of Living – Medicare Levy) Act 2024](https://www.legislation.gov.au/C2024A00004/asmade/text)
